content.short: Holders of Republic Note, a tokenized security on Avalanche, share in profits from Republic's venture portfolio.
content.description: Republic is a regulated investment platform that has backed hundreds of private companies. The Note is its way of sharing that upside. Whenever Republic exits a portfolio position at a profit, part of the proceeds goes into a dividend pool. Once the pool grows large enough, it is paid out to Note holders in USDC. Holders also get priority access to Republic deals and events. Once the dividend pool reaches $2 million it is paid out, and the Note trades on the INX platform. Republic also runs Republic Ventures and Republic Capital for accredited and institutional investors.
